announcements.headline: EQS-News: ams OSRAM joins Short-Reach Micro-Emitter Optics OCP standardization workstream led by Credo
announcements.insight: Joining this standardization workstream supports the Thin-Film VCSEL technology unveiled in September. This aligns with the strategic focus established after the non-optical sensor business sale in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: ams OSRAM unveils breakthrough Thin-Film VCSEL for AI Scale-Up, showcasing connectorized multi-core fiber solution and expanding ecosystem network
announcements.insight: The company unveils a new technology solution while following the July closure of its non-optical sensor business. Shareholders should watch for execution details regarding this ecosystem expansion.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: ams OSRAM closes the sale of its non‑optical analog/mixed-signal sensor business to Infineon for EUR 570 million in cash
announcements.insight: The sale of a business unit for cash represents a material disposal. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for financial impact details.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: ams-OSRAM AG: All voting items on the agenda at the Annual General Meeting of the ams-OSRAM AG approved by a clear majority
announcements.insight: Shareholders note that all agenda items at the Annual General Meeting were approved by a clear majority.
